about: Brokkr's claims register (decided by H, 3 October 2026; started 4 October 2026 with the figures). Every public claim lists its scope, whether it was pre-registered or exploratory, the prior work it is consistent with (verified references only), the command that produces it and the command that checks it. Numbers are never typed here: they live in the generated figures and docs/figures/figures.json, and in the README's generated findings block, which the check commands verify against the records. No claim of being first. Every paragraph of the website's Why labels? page names its entry (data-claim on the page), and every findings paragraph quoted on the site has an entry with its findings key; web/site_checks.py fails otherwise (H, 6 October 2026).

claims.claim: For MobileNetV3-Large, prediction sets calibrated on clean images keep their coverage target on clean images but fall below it under several kinds of damage, while the average set size doesn't grow to compensate; under strong low contrast (contrast (ImageNet-C) s5) the INT8 sets even get smaller.

scope.conditions: clean and the twelve damaged conditions on its label
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; prediction sets calibrated on the clean conformal-calibration split

claims.claim: Consistent with prior work on quantized models, shrunk models can pass a normal accuracy check and still collapse in dark or low-contrast images; in our small pre-registered test, we found no strong relation between clean accuracy and which models collapsed (a weak test with few models); in wider exploratory checks, which models were hit varied with the condition, and fog hit some models too.
